emptyState.title: No projects yet
emptyState.description: Create a project to group your servers and Units

environment.description: Choose where this project will work.
environment.isolatedHint: This server holds no credentials and can run externally-sourced tasks without approval.
environment.autoSelected: Auto-selected — there was only one option.
environment.serverTypeLocal: The local environment this hub runs on directly.
environment.serverTypeSsh: A remote server reached over SSH.
environment.serverTypeAgent: A remote server reached through an agent process.
environment.noServersAvailable: Every server is already configured for this project. There is nothing left to add.
environment.alreadyAddedError: "{{server}}" is already configured for this project and cannot be added again.

code.modeExistingDescription: Use a directory that already exists on the server as this project's working root.
code.modeCloneDescription: Clone the specified repository to set up a new working root.
code.modeLaterDescription: Set up the code later — only the environment will be created for now.
code.pathWillBeCreated: This path does not exist yet. It will be created.
code.cloneDirectoryMustBeAbsolute: Please enter an absolute path (starting with /).
code.cloneNote: This repository will be provisioned via distribution the first time a task runs on this server. Cloning does not happen here.
code.cloneNoteLocal: This repository will be cloned directly into the target directory on the hub, right now.
code.repoReusedHint: This project already has a credentialed repository registered for this URL — it will be reused, and no new token is needed.
code.cloneTokenHint: The token is stored on the hub only and never reaches the target server. The hub uses it to fetch the repository and deliver it as a bundle.
code.cloneTokenRequired: An access token is required to deliver this repository to a non-local server.
code.laterNote: Only the environment (server + root) will be created; no repository will be registered.

repoCandidates.empty: No candidates found. You can still enter a URL directly.
repoCandidates.truncated: There are more results — try narrowing your search.

code.modeDistributeDescription: The hub fetches the repository and pushes it to this server as a bundle. Nothing is cloned here.
code.isolatedTitle: Code is delivered to this server via the hub
code.isolatedBundle: The hub fetches the repository, builds a bundle, and sends it to this server. There is no other way to place code here.
code.isolatedNoCredentials: This server holds no git credentials, so it cannot fetch the repository itself.
code.isolatedOriginReplaced: The delivered checkout's origin is replaced with a dummy URL — this server cannot push directly.
code.distributionDirectoryHint: If a repository already exists there, its origin must match the source repository. The hub aborts delivery when it does not.

confirm.alreadyCreatedNotice: Steps already completed are kept. You can retry from the step that failed.
confirm.distributionOnNoRepo: Delivered via the hub (no source repository set)
confirm.tmuxSessionHint: Leave empty to let AZITO use its default session name.
confirm.inputPolicyHint: How externally-sourced input is handled in this environment.
confirm.inputPolicyAllowIsolatedOnly: "Allow without approval" is only available for an isolated server's environment.

errors.cloneTokenRequired: An access token is required to deliver this repository to a non-local server.
errors.serverTypeUnresolved: Could not determine server "{{server}}"'s type yet — please wait a moment and try again.

general.slugHint: Used as tmux session name. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
general.iconHint: Emoji or uploaded image displayed on the project sidebar
general.colorHint: Accent color for the project sidebar icon
general.unitPromptHint: Project-level instructions for all Units. Combined with each Unit's own system prompt.
general.unitPromptPlaceholder: e.g. This is a Next.js application using TypeScript...

general.defaultUnitHint: Used for tasks in this project that don't specify their own Unit.

repositories.tip: Tip: Use the Repositories tab in the activity bar to browse issues.

discover.title: Discover Repositories
discover.empty: No git repositories with remotes were found in the working directory.

repositories.removeConfirmMessage: This unregisters the repository from this project. The remote repository itself is not deleted.

windows.title: Windows
windows.noWindowsHint: Register a tmux window with this project to open it as a workspace tab.

servers.distributeCodeHint: The hub distributes this project's code to this server on the hub's own credentials, so a dev environment is ready even without git credentials on the server. Defaults off.
servers.distributeCodeIsolatedHint: Isolated servers hold no git credentials of their own, so code distribution is always on and cannot be turned off.
servers.distributionRepositoryHint: Which repository the hub distributes onto this server. Required while distribution is on — never inferred, even when the project has only one repository.
servers.distributionRepositoryRequired: Select a distribution repository — required while distribution is on.
servers.inputPolicyHint: Controls whether tasks imported from an external source (e.g. a GitHub/GitLab issue) may run on this server. Defaults to requiring manual approval.
servers.inputPolicyAllowHint: Runs automatically without approval — only effective on a verified isolated server. Automatically falls back to manual approval when verification is missing, expired, or scoped auth is disabled.
servers.noServersHint: Link a server and a working directory to this project so tasks have somewhere to run.
servers.distributionRepositoryOriginHint: While distribution is on, the working directory's origin remote is replaced with a dummy URL, so you cannot push manually from that directory.
servers.removeConfirmMessage: This only removes the link between this project and the server (working directory, branch and distribution settings). No files on the server are deleted.

distribution.failedGeneric: Distribution cannot run — tasks cannot execute

failed.serviceNotWired: Distribution is unavailable — tasks cannot execute
failed.noWorkingDir: No working directory set — tasks cannot execute
failed.noDistributionRepository: No distribution repository set — tasks cannot execute
failed.distributionRepositoryNotFound: Distribution repository not found — tasks cannot execute
failed.noToken: No token registered for the distribution repository — tasks cannot execute
failed.credentialUnreadable: The distribution repository's credential cannot be read — tasks cannot execute
failed.identityUnresolvable: The distribution repository's owner/name cannot be resolved — tasks cannot execute

secrets.note: Values registered here are injected as environment variables (AZITO_SECRET_<NAME>) into task execution panes. Only register credentials that are safe to share with agents. Values cannot be retrieved after saving.
secrets.nameValidation: Name must contain only A-Z, 0-9, _ (max 64 chars)
secrets.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete secret "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.

danger.description: Deleting a project will remove all associated windows and server configurations. Tasks will remain but will no longer be linked to this project.
danger.deleteConfirmMessage: Delete this project? This cannot be undone.
